title: The transcript reads like a Claude Code session: ⏺ lines, tool blocks with a ⎿ result, long output folded
name: tool-blocks
description: The lines inside the frame. Replace the per-line `<li>` rendering in `apps/dashboard/src/logs/Logs.tsx` with a transcript component (e.g. `logs/Transcript.tsx`): agent text as a `⏺` line rendered as markdown (reuse `src/markdown.tsx`), a tool call and its result grouped into one block (`⏺ Read(path)` then `⎿ 92 lines`), output over a few lines folded behind a click, `raw` stderr in the danger tone, human answers marked as coming from this side. Colours only from the transcript tokens transcript-adr adds. Grouping logic lives in `logs/data.ts` so it is tested without a screen. Build on what line-detail puts on the wire, per the line-shape decision.

brief.approach:
This node renders the lines inside the frame session-shell built, ported from `docs/design/watch-the-run.html`. It builds on line-detail's `LogLine`: `at`, `call`, `detail`, kind `output` with `body`.

1. **Grouping** is a pure function in `logs/data.ts`: `groupLines(lines): Block[]`.
   - A `tool` line and the later `output` line with the same non-null `call` form one block. When a call has more than one output, the last one wins.
   - A `tool` line with no `call` or no output yet is a block on its own, which shows it as pending.
   - An `output` whose call has not been seen yet is shown as its own block.
   - Every other kind is a single-line block.
   Also in `data.ts`:
   - `foldBody(body, max = 4)`: returns `{ shown, hidden }`. Up to 4 lines show whole; beyond that, 3 lines show plus `… +N lines`.
   - `elapsedLabel(at, startAt)`: formats `mm:ss`. When `at` is null it falls back to the line's arrival time, which `LogScreen` records as lines come in, because Claude carries no timestamps.
2. **Rendering** moves to a new `logs/Transcript.tsx`, taking the `<ol>` body out of `Logs.tsx`:
   - Agent `text` is a `⏺` line in ink, sans (`var(--font-transcript-sans)`), max 76ch. Keep text as typed; do not add markdown here. The comment above `LogScreen` explains why.
   - A tool block is `⏺ Tool(detail)` in `var(--tx-tool)`, mono (`var(--font-transcript-mono)`), with the tool glyph from `toolMark` in the mark column. Under it, indented, `⎿ summary` in `var(--tx-result)`. A body is folded with a `… +N lines (click to expand)` button (`type="button"`, `aria-expanded`), and expanding it does not break the reader's scroll follow.
   - `raw` uses `var(--tx-error)` with the `!` mark.
   - `answer` uses `›` in `var(--tx-human)`.
   - `started`, `check` and `checked` stay as today's dim rows. session-statusbar turns checks into the checklist card later.
   - The right column shows elapsed time (`<time dateTime={at}>`) and is hidden below 700px.
   - With `detail` null (old logs), a tool line renders the bare tool text exactly as today.
3. **Wiring.** `Logs.tsx` renders `<Transcript lines={filtered} startAt=… />` and keeps the find filter from session-shell. Keep the EKG and status bar out of `Transcript.tsx`; session-statusbar owns them in `Logs.tsx`.

**Tests:**
- `groupLines` in `data.test.ts`: pairing, last output wins, orphan output, no call, old logs.
- `foldBody` and `elapsedLabel` in `data.test.ts`.
- In `Logs.test.tsx`:
  - a tool block shows `Read(apps/x.ts)` and `⎿ 92 lines`;
  - a long body folds and expands;
  - raw uses `--tx-error`;
  - an old-style tool line still renders.

acceptance.proves: grouping, folding, elapsed labels and the block rendering behave, old logs included
the transcript renders from the pure grouping function, not ad-hoc in the component
nothing else in the dashboard broke
